rule_text: grant traverse on nodes (e:Asset) to E;
grant create on nodes (e:Asset) to E;
deny traverse on nodes (e:Secret) to C;
grant add{email} on nodes (u:Account) where u.owner = true to ProfileEditor;
grant read{email} on nodes (u:Account) to ProfileEditor;
grant read{address} on nodes (u:Account) to AddressEditor;
deny read{*} on nodes (u:Account) to AddressEditor;
grant read{diagnosis} on nodes (p:MedicalFile) to Doctor;
deny read{diagnosis} on nodes (p:MedicalFile) to Doctor;
grant add{status} on relationships (o:Purchase) where o.ownerId = user.id to OrderManager;
grant read{status} on relationships (o:Purchase) to OrderManager;
grant traverse on nodes (i:Invoice) where i.amount > 500 to G;
grant traverse on nodes (u:User) where u.age >= 18 AND u.age <= 65 to G;
